system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform action: Sends OTP for MIDH authentication. Here are my details: my mobile_number is 9876561989, my aadhaar_number is 100020006459.

function.name: midh_select_component
function.description: Selects a MIDH scheme component for the application. Returns component details, subsidy rates, and requirements. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if component_type unsupported or not available in the farmer's region.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: midh_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for MIDH authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.
